description: This file defines the EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity class, which implements the ITableEntity interface for representing partition checkpoint data for Azure Event Hubs in a tabular storage context. It includes properties for checkpoint details, constructors, and static methods for creating and generating partition and row keys.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity
classes.description: Represents an Azure Table entity for storing Event Hub partition checkpoint information, with methods for creating instances and generating keys.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity with specified stream provider name, service ID, and partition, setting appropriate partition and row keys.

methods.name: MakePartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized partition key string based on the stream provider name and checkpoint namespace.

methods.name: MakeRowKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized row key string based on the partition identifier.
